posts.t: Hi Trader for life - retail is no match with ITs,they can never compete
Yes I know that Harsh but my question was whether the retail orders (lots) are enough for IT's to fill their stomach or they play against themselves?

Most of the big banks are wholly or partially owned by the same small group of people. If I own Bank A and Bank B, then A taking B's money makes me no profit. I need to take money from retailers and banks I have less interest in. If I own part of Bank A and part of Bank B, then I can profit either way, as the other owners of each bank are risking capital which I don't own, yet.
